name: World of Discoveries
description: Sail back in time at this interactive museum and theme park. A boat tour and life-sized replicas make the voyages of Portuguese explorers a thrilling adventure for all.
longDescription:
The World of Discoveries is an interactive museum and theme park located in Miragaia, Porto, dedicated to the history of Portuguese maritime exploration. The venue aims to present the voyages and discoveries of Portuguese navigators through immersive exhibits and educational displays, making historical events accessible to a broad audience. It functions as both a museum showcasing historical context and a theme park offering engaging activities.

Visitors to the World of Discoveries can expect an immersive journey through the age of exploration. The experience includes a boat tour that navigates through recreated historical scenes and features life-sized replicas of figures and environments encountered by Portuguese explorers. The content is designed to be engaging for families, providing an educational yet entertaining perspective on historical events. The venue is situated in Miragaia, a riverside area of Porto.

Admission to the World of Discoveries requires tickets. The event runs from April 30th to May 6th, 2026. Miragaia is accessible via public transport, with bus stops in the vicinity. The venue is suitable for families.
